limits: Post hoc description; the prespecified21/29 failed continuation gate is unchanged.
Authenticated logs report actual training forward metrics and gradients; no forward/backward/optimizer transition is independently replayed here.
Lower epoch loss on a changing model is not a fixed-checkpoint evaluation, a convergence proof, or evidence that more training would help.
The residual-moment target changes as the mean predictor learns, so variance progress cannot establish conditional calibration or explain the failed gate causally.
Observed variance-head updates reject an entirely inactive/omitted auxiliary objective, but do not establish adequate optimization or a suitable parameterization.
Exposed training/development corpus and off-policy masking stress do not establish native control or fresh-test superiority.

method.epoch_metrics: Arithmetic mean of20 equal-sized32-episode minibatch metrics, each covering one full640-episode training pass with changing model parameters.
method.family_metrics: Equal average across all3 paired fits.
method.gradient_norms: Recorded preclip norms of the actual weighted loss; backbone and variance head clipped separately at10.
method.optimizer_activity: Saved final per-parameter Adam counters and first/second moment tensors; no update replay.
method.parameter_change: Float64 L2(final-initial), relative to initial L2, computed over named parameter groups.

scope: All12 fits/all1920 recorded updates, initial/final parameters and final Adam tensors; no development predictions or original corpus read.
